sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance 1981
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH
COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1981
CHAPTER
I‑PRELIMINARY
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance,
1981.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance 1981
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH

CHAPTER
I‑PRELIMINARY
2. Definitions. In this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context,‑
(a) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Commission;
(b) "Commission"
means the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO);
(c) "Committee" means
the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Committee established under
the Scientific and Technological Research Division Resolution dated the 8th
March 1966 ;
(d) "Council" means the Space Research Council
established under section 3;
(e) "Executive
Committee" means the Executive Committee ' of the Council;
(f) "prescribed"
means prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance; and
(g) "Secretary" means
the Secretary of the Commission.

Powers and functions of the council

CHAPTER
II CONSTITUTION OF SUPARCO
4. Powers and
functions of the Council.‑(1) The functions of the Council shall be‑
(a) to lay down the national policies and guidelines to be followed
by the Commission in the performance of its functions;
(b) to review the work of the Commission and to consider its annual
report;
(c) to consider the proposals,
schemes and projects submitted by the Commission; and
(d) to assign such special surveys, investigations and other
specified works to the Commission as it may consider necessary.
(2) The Council shall have the
power to control, direct and regulate the affairs of the Commission.

Establishment etc  of the executive commission

II CONSTITUTION OF SUPARCO
5.
Establishment, etc., of the Executive Committee.‑(1) There shall be
an Executive Committee of the Council consisting of‑--
(a) the Minister for Finance;
(b) the Minister or Adviser,
incharge of the subject of Science and Technology;
(c) the Cabinet Secretary;
(d) one scientist or engineer to be nominated by the President; and
(e) the Chairman, SUPARCO.
(2) The President may authorise any other person to
attend the meetings of the Executive Committee and function as a member.
(3) The meetings of the Executive Committee shall be
presided over by the Minister for Finance, and the Chairman shall act as
Secretary of the Executive Committee.
(4) The nominated member of the Executive Committee
shall hold office during the pleasure of the President.
(5) The meetings of the Executive Committee shall be
called by the Secretary, of the Executive Committee on such date and at such
place as may be specified by the Minister for Finance,

6. Functions of
the Executive Committee.‑The functions of the Executive Committee
shall be‑
(a) to oversee the affairs of
the Commission on behalf of the Council;
(b) to consider quarterly
progress reports of the Commission;
(c) to approve the annual
budget of the Commission; and
(d) to perform such other functions as may be delegated to it by
the Council.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance 1981

Establishment etc  of the commission

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH

CHAPTER
II CONSTITUTION OF SUPARCO
7. Establishment, etc., of the Commission. ‑41) As soon as
may be after the commencement of this Ordinance, the Federal Government shall
establish, in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance, a Commission to
be called the Pakistan Space arid Upper Atmosphere Research Commission.
(2) The Commission shall be a body corporate having
perpetual suc cession and a common seal with power, subject to the provisions
of this Ordinance, to acquire and hold property, both movable and immovable,
and shall by the said name sue and be sued.
(3) The headquarters of the
Commission shall be at Karachi.
(4) Until the
Commission is established under subsection (1), the Com mittee, functioning
immediately before the commencement of this Ordinance, shall, notwithstanding
its dissolution under section 21, continue to function and while so functioning
be deemed to be the Commission established under this section.

Composition  of the commission

PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH

CHAPTER
II CONSTITUTION OF SUPARCO
8. Composition of
the Commission.‑(1) The Commission shall consist of the following
members to be appointed by the President, namely
(a) Chairman.
(b) Member, Space Technology.
(c) Member, Space Electronics.
(d) Member, Space Research.
(e) Member, Finance.
(2) The members including the Chairman, shall hold
office during the pleasure of the President.
(3) The President may increase
or decrease the number of members of the Commission.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance 1981

Functions of the commission

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH

CHAPTER
II CONSTITUTION OF SUPARCO
9. Functions of
the Commission.‑The functions of the Commission shall be‑
(a) to prepare and submit to
the Council for its approval, proposals, schemes or projects necessary for the
achievement and promotion of its objectives;
(b) to undertake such special
serveys, investigations and other specialised works as may be assigned by the
Council;
(c) to prepare and submit to
the Executive Committee its quarterly progress reports;
(d) to prepare and submit to
the Executive Committee its annual budget for approval; and
(e) to do all acts and things
including research and development work necessary for the execution of policies
laid down by the Council.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance 1981
sections.description:
Meetings of the commission

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH
COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1981
CHAPTER
II CONSTITUTION OF SUPARCO
10. Meetings of the Commission.‑(1) Save as hereinafter provided,
the Commission shall regulate its own procedure for its meetings.
(2) The annual report and the accounts of the
Commission for each financial year shall be submitted by the Secretary at a
meeting of the Commission to be held within six months of the close of that
year for adoption.
(3) To constitute a quorum at a meeting of the
Commission, not less than three members including the Chairman, shall be
present.
(4) All meetings of the
Commission shall , be presided over by the Chairman and, in the absence of the
Chairman, by a member of the Commission authorised in writing by the Chairman
and, in the absence of such authorization or of the member so authorised, by a
member elected for the purpose by the members present.
(5) All questions at a meeting of the Commission
shall be decided by a majority vote and in case of equality of votes the person
presiding shall have a second or casting vote Providing that, in the event of a
difference of opinion between the Finance Member and a majority of the other
members of the Commission in any matter having financial implications, the
matter shall, if the Finance Member so desires, be referred to the Executive
Committee for a decision. .
(6) Any urgent business of the Commission may be
transacted by circulation among all its members, and any proposal so circulated
and approved by a majority of the members shall be as effective and binding as
if such proposal had been passed at a regular meeting of the Commission.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance 1981

Powers of the chairman

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH
COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1981
CHAPTER
II CONSTITUTION OF SUPARCO
11. Powers of the Chairman.‑(1) The Chairman shall
be the Chief Executive Officer of the Commission and shall, subject to such
directions as the Council or the Executive Committee may give from time to
time, exercise all such powers as are necessary to direct and control the
affairs ‑of the Commission in accordance with this Ordinance.
(2) The Chairman may, subject to rules and
regulations made under this Ordinance, appoint, employ on contract or on a part
time basis or otherwise such officers, consultants, advisers and other staff as
are considered necessary for the efficient working of the Commission.
(3) The Chairman may delegate
all or any of his powers to any member or officer of the Commission.

Funds of the commission

CHAPTER III‑FUNDS OF THE
COMMISSION
12. Funds of
the Commission.‑(1) The funds of the Commission shall consist of ‑
(i) grants‑in‑aid
from the Federal Government and Provincial Governments;
(ii) donations and endowments
of money approved by the Federal Government;
(iii) income from investments
and royalties; and
(iv) receipts from such other
sources as may be approved by the Commission.
(2) The Commission may open its account with any
scheduled Bank of Pakistan.

13. Audit and
accounts.‑‑(1) The Commission shall prepare and submit its
annual budget to the Executive Committee showing the estimated receipts and
expenditure and the sums likely to be required from the Federal Govern ment
during the next financial year before the end of March every year.
(2) The accounts of the Commission shall be audited
by the Auditor- General of Pakistan.

International co-operation

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH
COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1981
CHAPTER IV‑MISCELLANEOUS
14. International Co‑operation.‑The Commission may, subject
to the prior approval of the Federal Government, co‑operate with any
international organization for furthering peaceful uses of space and
applications of space sciences and technology pursuant to the terms and
conditions of any programme or agreement
for co‑operation to which such organization is a party or pursuant to any
other international agreement made before or after the commencement of this
Ordinance.

15. Discoveries and
Inventions.‑‑‑All rights relating to discoveries and
inventions and any improvement in materials, methods, processes, apparatus or
equipment made by any officer or employee of the Commission in the course of
his employment shall vest in the Commission.

prescribed.

17. Submission of reports, etc.‑The Commission
shall submit to the Federal Government at such intervals as the Federal
Government may specify‑
(a) such periodical reports and summaries as may be
required by the Federal Government; and
(b) such information and comments as may be asked for
by the Federal Government on any specific point.

18. Continuance of
certain rules.‑All rules, regulations, orders and instructions of the
Committee in force immediately before the commencement of this Ordinance shall,
mutatis mudandis and so far as they
are not inconsis tent with any of the provisions of this Ordinance, continue in
force until repealed or altered by rules or regulations made under this
Ordinance.

XXIII of 1969 not to apply to Commission.‑Nothing contained in the

20. Winding up of the
Commission.‑No provision of law relating to the winding up of bodies
corporate shall apply to the Commission and the Commission shall not be wound
up except by order of the Federal Govern ment and in such manner as the Federal
Government may direct.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance 1981
sections.description:
Dissolution of the committee

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH
COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1981
CHAPTER IV‑MISCELLANEOUS
21. Dissolution of the Committee.‑Upon the commencement of this
Ordinance the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Committee shall
stand dissolved and upon such dissolution‑
(i) all assets, rights, powers,
authorities and privileges, and all property, movable and immovable, cash and
bank balance, reserve funds, investments and all other interests and rights in,
or arising out of, such property and all debts, liabilities and obligations of
whatever kind of the Committee subsisting immediately before its dissolution
shall stand transferred to and vest in the Commission;
(ii) all contracts entered into
and all matters and things engaged to be done by, with or for the Committee
before such dissolution shall be deemed to have been entered into or engaged to
be done by, with or for the Commission; and
(iii) all suits and other legal
proceedings instituted by or against the Committee before such dissolution
shall be deemed to be suits and proceedings by or against the Commission and
shall be proceeded or otherwise dealt with accordingly.

PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH

CHAPTER IV‑MISCELLANEOUS
22. Transfer of existing employees of the Committee to the
Commission.--- All officers, consultants, advisers and other staff, employed
in any capacity in the Committee immediately before the commencement of this
Ordinance shall stand transferred for service under the Commission on the same
terms and conditions to which they were entitled immediately before such
commencement and such terms and conditions shall not be varied to their
disadvantage.

23. Power to make rules.‑The Federal Government
may, by notification in the official Gazette, make rules for carrying out the
purposes of this Ordinance.

24. Power to make regulations.‑.The Commission
may, with the previous approval of the Executive Committee make such
regulations not inconsistent with the provisions of this Ordinance and the
riles made thereunder as it may consider necessary or expedient for the
administration and management of the affairs of the Commission.

ORDINANCE XX OF 1981
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH
COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1981
CHAPTER IV‑MISCELLANEOUS
25. Removal of difficulties.‑If any difficulty
arises in giving effect to any of the provisions of this Ordinance, the Federal
Government may make such order, not inconsistent with the provisions of this
Ordinance, as may appear to it to be necessary for the purpose of removing the
difficulty.
